from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial metric value reported by one company in one filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this report belongs to, as named in the document")
    financial_item: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label for the financial metric")
    financial_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported value as a float; negative values indicate losses")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Brief excerpt showing the item and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
